plugins.name: acceptance-e2e
plugins.description: Turn a feature's requirements + the running app into an acceptance-criteria-traceable e2e suite in the project's own e2e harness — then go proactive: seven driven-and-asserted sweeps beyond the ACs (state-matrix forcing via interception, fault injection incl. offline/timeout/double-submit, interaction-integrity + reactivity, keyboard + axe a11y floor, data-shape stress over API-seeded edge fixtures, security surface incl. forged-action/IDOR/channel-authz, multi-user two-context realtime), a rendered-quality handoff that invokes the /design-review skill (deterministic WCAG/layout gates + judged craft/state/flow passes) and the mockup-fidelity layer where a design-of-record exists, surgical fixes for tractable bugs, and guard promotion — every sweep becomes a permanent CI/pre-push gate invoked by a named script, with new surfaces inheriting by enumeration. Coverage axes are enumerated and the sample declared up front; committed specs carry their run record. Lanes for native apps (Maestro deep-link-first, XCUITest, performAccessibilityAudit, and an Accessibility-tree runner for macOS apps XCUITest cannot reach - assert AXPress not just identifiers, fixture-mode determinism that also avoids stealing foreground focus, and the measured traps that make an AX harness blame the app), MCP servers (acceptance = a real MCP client driving the built server), and marketing sites (route x viewport loads, link/heading/meta audits, claim-grounding invariants). v1.4.0 phases 0-9, from the portfolio QA plan + the WEB-4905 audit. v1.6.0 moves the default runner off @playwright/test to node:test driving Obscura over CDP, wires the a11y floor by injecting axe-core (color-contrast lands in incomplete, never violations, under that engine), and states plainly what the conversion costs: no fixtures, no auto-retry, no parallel workers, no HTML reporter, no trace viewer.

plugins.name: bench-qa
plugins.description: Quality-assurance automation for the diolog-swe-bench benchmark corpus: judge whether a task is difficult enough and fairly verified (bench-task-judge), re-run the whole-corpus review with any model (bench-corpus-review), and author new gated tasks including ui design tasks (bench-task-author).

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: High-signal code review for NestJS, Next.js (App Router)/React 19, frontend HTML/CSS/React, and React Native. Depth levels (quick/standard/deep) scale token cost; area targeting (frontend, nest, next, mobile, paths) and focus lenses (bugs, security, perf, tests, components, a11y, dead-code, debt, deps, dx) scope each run; a token-light prepush gate scans the outgoing diff. Modular checklist routing, mitigating-controls auto-discovery, parallel sharding for large diffs, independent batched Sonnet verifier fan-out with five gates (API existence, versions, mitigation-elsewhere, proportionality, reachability), and cross-run learned suppressions. Quality lenses adapted from shadcn's improve skill (MIT); noise-reduction patterns from 2025-26 AppSec research (Corgea, Aikido, ZeroPath).

plugins.name: create-amy-content
plugins.description: Write any content in Amy Benson's authentic voice (Diolog Founder & CEO), routed through eight persona variants: LinkedIn posts and thought leadership, long-form articles/blog posts, marketing content (announcements, launch/landing copy grounded in the diolog.app copy she curated and aligned with the Diolog voice & audience guide), sales/partnership outreach email (cold intros, consultative follow-ups, objection handling, gracious declines), Diolog investor updates, Slack/chat messages, short-form, and speaking notes for panels/podcasts/pitches. One evidence-anchored base voice (warm first, sharp underneath, direct questions with low-pressure asks, spaced-hyphen habit, no em dashes, AU spelling) synthesised from ~5,000 words of her verbatim email, LinkedIn, Slack and interview corpus (bundled, redacted), with a deterministic voice lint carrying her measured stylometric fingerprint. Generated with the create-voice-persona factory. v1.3 folds in Amy's own editorial review: broken-up LinkedIn formatting, genuine-question closes, peer-audience floor, referent discipline, register fencing for marketing, plain offer phrasing, no meta-labels, and retired phrases (bricks/Rome, 'came up through') enforced by the lint. v1.4 refreshes the bundled AI-signs field guide with the July 2026 empirical research layer and encodes the research-backed guards (plain copulas, epigram budget, hook-transition bans) in the base voice and lint config. v1.4.1 syncs the field guide's once-per-document epigram/contrast rule. v1.5 syncs the repeated-phrase lint check and the updated field guide (countable texture budgets, scaffold-slot trap). v1.5.1 field-guide sync. v1.5.2 lint pattern sync. v1.6 adds the meetings corpus: ~150k words of Amy's live sales/discovery calls (2025-26, six segments, redacted) distilled into references/research/amy-meetings-corpus.md - spoken hedge hierarchy corrected (kind of / I guess / to be honest dominate; I'd say / I find demoted to interview register), signature live moves encoded (the honesty-ask, resonance checks, conscious-of-time wind-down, affirm-and-redirect, concede-and-credit, the origin set-piece, live analogy-making), and the motto register-fenced (interview/keynote evidence, never observed on calls). Machine-transcript caveat binding: lexicon and moves only, never mechanics. v1.6.1 lint sync (quiet-claim advisories).

plugins.name: create-company-deck
plugins.description: Build a high-quality self-contained HTML slide deck for a named company from three inputs — its company overview, its DESIGN.md design tokens, and a source document or prompt — assembling slides from a bundled library of proven layout templates and generating photography with the media-gen-pro MCP. Use whenever someone wants a deck, slides, a presentation, a quarterly or results deck, an investor update, a board pack or a strategy deck built for a specific company, especially when they hand over a company overview, brand tokens and an announcement or brief and ask for slides from them. Carries a generated theme block derived from the company's own type ramp by a single ratio, fifteen filled-and-numbered slide layouts, the figure-ledger and zero-based-axis discipline a disclosure-derived deck needs, media-gen-pro prompt and grade-lock recipes with the never-a-real-person rule, and a measured gate suite for four render failures that are invisible in a screenshot — stage clipping, print containing-block collapse, copy painted under a full-bleed image, and pinned chrome stretched by the wrapper-collapse guard. Supplies its own missing inputs — company-overview-from-website crawls the overview and design-md-from-website measures the DESIGN.md off the same site — so a company URL plus a source document is enough to start, and hands the built deck to design-review before completion. Carries a Diolog studio-runner target (references/eve-runner.md) so the same grounding governs decks authored as diolog.deck-source/1 deck.json by the Eve agent, where the HTML shell and scripts do not apply. Not for a .pptx or editable Office handoff (deck-craft's lecturn JSON target), an investor portal page (create-investor-portal-free), or a deck with no brand and no source material (deck-craft's direction round).

plugins.name: create-diolog-content
plugins.description: Write any content in Diolog's company voice, routed through four register personas: long-form A4 guide copy (the master files create-diolog-guides renders), articles/blog posts (investor education, IR best practice, thought leadership, announcements), website + email marketing copy, and buyer-facing business cases. Successor to the diolog-brand-voice skills, rebuilt on the create-amy-content architecture: one evidence-anchored base voice (plain and literal beats clever, the skim test, epigram budgets, verbatim positioning beats, measured confidence shown never stated, spaced hyphen never em dashes, AU English) synthesised from the team voice guide, the live diolog.app copy, and Amy's line-by-line 2026-07 review of shipped AI-drafted long-form; a review ledger that compounds future corrections; the July 2026 empirical anti-AI-writing research layer; and a deterministic voice lint with per-register format budgets. v1.0.1 adds the stylometric fingerprint extracted from ~26k words of the live diolog.com.au corpus (marketing pages, non-legal help articles, all blog articles; AI-drafted resources excluded). v1.1 adds the revision protocol (item-by-item feedback disposition - applied/overruled/routed-and-landed - plus restatement and duplication sweeps) after the guide revision validated clean on copy rules but evaporated routed design feedback, left a stale spec restatement, and duplicated an epigram across a spread; ledger entries 10-12 record the classes. v1.2, from a blind generalisation test (clean-room generation on a fresh topic, class-blind adversarial review): seeded approved sample anchors with an approval-plus-clean-lint admission rule and an accretion loop; data-shaped colour counts as a claim; scaffold slots never filled with invented psychology; countable texture budgets replace vary-by-intention; lint gains the repeated-phrase check and repeat_allowlist; ledger entries 13-15. v1.3 separates rulebook from casebook: the review ledger is maintenance-only and out of the drafting/review load path, model-facing files carry each rule with at most one generic illustration (verbatim case history lives only in the ledger), and a fresh-eyes constraint forbids document recognition from framing or substituting for a rules pass - so the skill can be tested fairly on previously reviewed material. v1.3.1: role descriptions carry their object (compressed abstraction applied to people), rewrite-from-disk guard in the revision protocol, and the fingerprint section's stale 'no fingerprint yet' prose corrected. v1.4 makes the Amy lineage explicit: the positioning-beats library is now annotated with live confirmations from her sales calls (both taglines verbatim, 2026), gains her live-confirmed beats (human in the loop, not-a-replacement/superpower, the internal-auditor metaphor for the Compliance Guardian, disclosure risk vs AI risk), and fences the retired pre-Nov-2025 'investor chat repository' positioning against regeneration. v1.4.1 generalises the naming rule: names describe contents and function, never the promised outcome (measured confidence applied to naming) - closing the reframe-the-promise loophole without storing any vetoed phrase. v1.5: the review ledger enters the drafting/review load path by owner decision (blind-testing phase closed) - consulted when judgement is close, with two permanent guards: recognition of reviewed material is never announced as a finding, and revisions disposition the supplied feedback rather than replaying history. v1.5.1: quiet claim shapes added to the data-shaped-colour rule (lint-backed), and use-bridges are treated as product claims - unverified capabilities get a named production-note gate, never a blanket shipped-truth assertion. Recalibrated for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance): a new all-formats constraint that content is written to the length its destination allows — default output runs long and the drift is invisible from inside the draft (a landing section becomes three paragraphs, a guide page overflows its A4, an article pads its middle), so the target is stated before drafting and content is cut to fit rather than type shrunk or the argument thinned.

plugins.name: create-diolog-guides
plugins.description: Build a multi-page, print-ready A4 guide in Diolog's brand design system as one self-contained HTML file that scrolls as a document on screen, exports to a clean A4 PDF, and carries screen-only micro-interactions that never reach the print. Use whenever the deliverable runs longer than one page: a guide, briefing, playbook, handbook, whitepaper, explainer, report, or 'turn this markdown into something we can send investors'. Sibling of create-diolog-infographic, which lands one finding on one page; this one sustains an argument across twenty, which is a systems problem rather than a composition problem. Mandates a design layer before any page exists (a spacing scale, a column grid, one shared baseline, print-first type, motion tokens), shapes the document into three to five page archetypes rather than twenty one-offs, and gates each archetype through design-craft's per-unit critique before reproducing it. Renders approved company-voice copy verbatim and builds all imagery as live HTML and CSS rather than raster. Ships a zero-dependency Node CDP harness that measures ink rather than boxes: guide-qa (cap-height alignment via baseline probe and canvas TextMetrics, optical gutters, stretch voids, orphan wrap rows, spacing-scale adherence, cross-page baseline drift, clamped-box centre drift, Range-based widows, WCAG AA contrast with alpha blended up the ancestor chain, plus per-component crops at DPR 3), scope-lint (selectors that cross a component boundary, dead rules, colliding global classes), page-fit (A4 fit plus the collisions overflow:hidden conceals, footer overlap, computed font families), motion-check (print and reduced-motion resting-state safety, then mid-flight frame capture), and export-pdf (verifies the produced PDF's page count, sheet size, link annotations, and that no transient animation label leaked into the ink). Carries an explicit verification epistemics: a gate is downstream of the findings that motivated it, so a clean gate means no known defect is present and never means verified; rendering a screenshot is not looking at one; and motion bugs exist only in mid-flight frames. Leans on design-craft and ux-craft (both blocking) and on create-luke-content or create-amy-content when copy must be authored rather than rendered. Not for a single-page infographic or poster (create-diolog-infographic), multi-slide decks (customer-deck-builder), email mockups (email-mockups), or app UI (design-craft). v1.0.1 documents the mixed-size-initial optical-centring pattern (a larger serif initial beside smaller mono caps rides high when baseline-aligned; nudge it down by half its cap-height surplus via transform) and two DOM ink-measurement traps (text-transform:uppercase means the measured string is not the rendered one; getComputedStyle metrics differ per font family so crop and look when the numbers fight you) - noting that the cap-misalign gate does not cover decorative initials, a live instance of the gate-sees-only-what-it-was-configured-for thesis. v1.1.0 adds the evidence-based emphasis-and-legibility layer from the July 2026 typography deep research: a binding per-page emphasis budget (italics display-only - the heading accent plus one isolated pull quote; micro-labels mono roman at or above the 11px floor; uppercase only for labels of five words or fewer; bold 1-2 phrases per paragraph), hierarchy via size steps and white space rather than font styling, row-major ordering for grouped sequences, pull quotes isolated outside the body flow, and the rule that this evidence outranks a master file's ad-hoc design notes - motivated by the italics overload and hierarchy flattening Amy's review caught in the shipped 30-questions guide. v1.2 adds references/design-review.md - the reviewer-correction ledger and the receiver for design feedback routed from other skills, seeded with the 2026-07 guide review's design items (cover grid texture, vertical ToC, section-opener hierarchy, label legibility, back-matter-earns-its-place, use-bridge room, unstable background effects); open items are debts a guide may not ship against silently. v1.2.1 makes the references conditionally loadable rather than passively listed: a 'References - read each when its trigger fires' table maps every reference doc (grid-and-tokens, emphasis-and-legibility, design-review, page-archetypes, verification, motion-layer, the typography research appendix) to the exact workflow step or condition that should pull it into context, and verification.md - the most important doc, previously only pointed at with an arrow - gets an explicit 'read before you trust any gate' trigger at the gate step. Progressive disclosure only works if the criteria for reading each doc are written down; this makes them so. Recalibrated for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance): Step 7's honest-delivery report is held to its three lists (gates run, images opened, what was not checked) — written output runs long by default, and a note that restates the design decisions buries the not-checked list, which is the one thing a reader needs from it.

plugins.name: create-diolog-infographic
plugins.description: Create a print-ready, single-page A4 infographic in Diolog's brand design system to communicate one finding, comparison, or metric (a benchmark result, a cost or quality trade-off, a KPI, a 'we measured X' story). Themes everything from the live Diolog website design system (financial-broadsheet plus instrument-panel: Newsreader serif with one italic accent, Inter body, JetBrains Mono for tickers and data labels, navy ground used once, one blue accent, accent-bright for data on navy only, semantic colour always paired with a dot or sign, no em or en dashes, sentence case, no second hue, no emoji, no hype). Writes any copy in Luke's voice via create-luke-content and runs its voice lint. Embeds the three brand fonts inline as base64 so the page is self-contained for print and for publishing as an Artifact, and pulls the diolog droplet mark plus lowercase wordmark. Charts a finding honestly (equal-length tracks with differing fills for proportions, x versus y with both values shown and the winner styled, one dominant focal number, never a comparison of success or task counts) and verifies the page renders and fits exactly one A4 page (~794x1123px at 96dpi) by serving over http, rendering with a cache-busting URL, measuring the page height, confirming the fonts loaded, and trimming until it fits. Leans on design-craft and ux-craft for visual and UX craft. Use whenever someone wants an infographic, a one-pager, a shareable stat graphic, a poster of a result, or a designed chart of data in the Diolog look, even if they only say 'turn these numbers into something I can share'. Not for multi-page guides, briefings or whitepapers (create-diolog-guides), multi-slide decks (customer-deck-builder), email product mockups (email-mockups), or a full website or app UI (design-craft). v1.2 adds a mandatory Step 0 design layer (a spacing scale every value draws from, print-first type, a margin column sized to its widest glyph run, line-height 1 on display glyphs, optical nudges via transform not margin), a Looking Contract for verification (rendering a screenshot is not looking at one; ask each capture "what is wrong with this?" not "is this done?"; crop to components at DPR 2-3 because a page thumbnail cannot resolve the defect; a clean gate means no known defect is present and never means verified, and the two claims are reported separately), ink measurement via a baseline probe plus canvas TextMetrics rather than getBoundingClientRect boxes, named layout anti-patterns to grep for (space-between, flex:1, margin-top:auto), and routing of any multi-page deliverable to create-diolog-guides. Recalibrated for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance): the render-and-measure verification is now first-person rather than delegated to a verifier subagent — it is a handful of tool calls, and an agent spawned to re-check a page you just built spends a whole context telling you what a crop would.

plugins.name: create-disclosure-consistency-page
plugins.description: Turn a Diolog web-app disclosure-consistency report into a standalone, on-brand HTML artifact a Disclosure Committee can read, print and circulate before an announcement is released. Takes the saved HTML of the app's consistency-check page plus the subject company's DESIGN.md and produces one self-contained file: decision first, the items to resolve, an honest coverage bar, every tested statement, the supporting record and the anticipated questions. Use this whenever someone hands over a disclosure consistency report, a consistency check, a pre-release disclosure audit or an "AI compliance check" and wants it as a shareable or printable page, wants the app's report turned into a document, wants the Alfabs consistency audit rebuilt for another company or another quarter, or asks for a consistency report restyled in a company's brand - even if they only say "make this report look good" or "turn this export into something I can send the board". Treats the app HTML as the sole source of truth and invents nothing: no report IDs, owners, due dates or attributions the source does not carry. Reframes the app's misleading pass-rate as checked-versus-not-checked coverage, because a statement nobody could check has not been found inconsistent. Not for building an investor portal (use create-investor-portal-free) or for running the consistency analysis itself.

plugins.name: create-investor-portal-free
plugins.description: Build a complete, single-page public investor portal for a listed company from its DESIGN.md design-token file and a company overview markdown file, branded entirely in that company's own tokens with a Diolog banner, app band and footer credit layered on top. Use this whenever someone wants an investor portal, investor page, investor relations page, IR site, shareholder page or "investor hub" built for a specific company, wants the Alfabs investor portal rebuilt for a different issuer, hands over a DESIGN.md plus a company overview and asks for a site or landing page from them, or asks for an investor-facing page that search engines and AI assistants can cite - even if they only say "make ACME an investor page from these two files" or "do what we did for Alfabs but for this company". Orders the page on research into what search-referred and LLM-referred investors actually need (dated sourced company facts first, disclosures second, share price demoted beneath both, governance as required ASX furniture), emits Corporation structured data and a crawler-permissive robots.txt, and carries the ASX Listing Rule 15.7, Listing Rule 4.10.3 and section 769C constraints that shape the build. Not for a disclosure-consistency audit page (use create-disclosure-consistency-page), a Diolog-brand marketing page (design-craft), or a DESIGN.md extracted from a site (design-md-from-website).

plugins.name: create-luke-content
plugins.description: Write any content in Luke Rhodes' authentic voice (Diolog CTO and co-founder), conditionally routed through the right persona variant for the content type: LinkedIn posts and long-form blog articles (engagement-optimised, with a Diolog graphic concept), marketing content (announcements, release notes, landing copy, campaign emails), code reviews (severity-calibrated candour), informal-but-professional Slack messages, short-form content (tweets, comments, bios), and ADHD-targetted / book-audience writing (the conversational brilliant-colleague register). One non-negotiable base voice (calm, direct, technically fluent, quietly witty, no em dashes, no AI clichés) synthesised from Luke's raw writing corpus, five persona deltas layered on top, and a deterministic voice-lint with per-format advisory checks. Formerly create-luke-article. v2.3 ports the owner-review learnings from the Amy package: signature-phrase rations with a retired-list mechanism, distribution-not-formula rhythm, referent discipline, peer-audience floor, genuine-question-or-no-question closes, register fencing, and a self-narrating meta-label ban (lint-enforced). v2.3.2 refreshes the bundled AI-signs field guide with the July 2026 empirical research layer. v2.3.3 syncs the field guide's once-per-document epigram/contrast rule. v2.4 syncs the repeated-phrase lint check and the updated field guide (countable texture budgets, scaffold-slot trap). v2.4.1 field-guide sync. v2.4.2 lint pattern sync. v2.4.3 lint sync (quiet-claim advisories).

plugins.name: create-persona
plugins.description: Generates dense, agent-ready persona definitions from a target role — identity kernel, responsibility matrix with classification tags ([CRITICAL] / [WORKFLOW] / [POWER-USER] / [GOLDEN-NUGGET]), decision frameworks, maturity model, selection matrix, capability heat map, dependency graph, metrics, constraints, and two interaction examples. Tuned to current Claude model behaviour (literalism, adaptive thinking, positive framing). Evidence base from 2025 persona research (EmoCharacter, LABE, PPA, CPER, Over-Specification Paradox) ships in references/playbook.md.

plugins.name: create-storyboard
plugins.description: Build an interactive UI storyboard as a StyleX + Storybook project from a product specification and a user-supplied DESIGN.md. The DESIGN.md (the product's own brand/design system) drives the look — this skill is NOT locked to a macOS aesthetic and renders in whatever visual identity the brand specifies. It reads a bundled HIG library purely as the interaction, behaviour, structure, and accessibility backbone (layout, master–detail/list/table grammar, modality, feedback, focus/keyboard, motion, empty/loading/error/status, writing), applies the design-craft and frontend-design skills for distinctive, accessible, AI-slop-resistant direction, derives the user flows + screens, builds a reusable StyleX design system (tokens → elements → composites) from the DESIGN.md, and implements every screen as Storybook stories across the happy / empty / loading / error / AI states at production fidelity, plus an MDX flow-overview that sequences the screens into journeys. A brand-driven sibling of macosify's macos-storyboard skill (which is locked to a macOS-native look).

plugins.name: create-voice-persona
plugins.description: Build a complete, reusable voice persona package for any person from examples of their real writing — the generalised factory behind the create-luke-content pattern. Mines a writing corpus into an evidence-anchored base voice (every rule traced to a quoted sample), layers purpose-tailored persona variants on top (LinkedIn posts as the flagship, grounded in bundled LinkedIn engagement deep research plus any user-supplied research; plus long-form, marketing, short-form, chat, email, code review, speaker notes), generates a per-person deterministic voice lint, and bundles a distilled 'Signs of AI writing' field guide (from Wikipedia's WP:AISIGNS) so everything the persona writes avoids every known AI tell. Delivers a ready-to-install create-X-content plugin skill or a portable docs folder. v1.1 adds a stylometric layer grounded in voice-replication research: word-count corpus grading, syntactic-fingerprint extraction (sentence rhythm, contractions, nominalizations) enforced as lint advisories, anchor-diversity and style/content-entanglement rules, NNG tone dials per variant, and long-form drift re-anchoring. v1.3 adds an owner-feedback maintenance loop (corrections as highest-grade evidence, fix-the-class discipline, retired-phrase mechanism) plus guards distilled from real owner reviews: signature-phrase rations, distribution-not-formula rhythm, referent discipline, audience-knowledge floor, register fencing, and a self-narrating meta-label tell. v1.4 adds the empirical research layer to the bundled AI-signs field guide (quantified structural tells from 2023-2026 corpus studies, the 99.6% expert-detection and AI Penalty evidence, structure-vs-texture discipline, epigram budgets, epistemic stance markers, flatten-and-reconstruct guidance) and threads the new guards through the package blueprint and self-check. v1.5 adds the feedback-disposition discipline (every review item applied, overruled with stated reason, or routed AND landed in the owner's ledger), the restatement sweep (a corrected spec updated everywhere it is stated), and the once-per-document epigram rule to the field guide. v1.6: blind-generalisation-test learnings - voice_lint.py gains a deterministic repeated-phrase check (once-per-document rule, with repeat_allowlist); the blueprint mandates accreting approved output as sample anchors (corrections alone cannot teach a voice); the field guide encodes countable texture budgets and the scaffold-slots-are-fabrication-traps corollary. v1.7 encodes the rulebook/casebook separation in the blueprint: ledgers are maintainer-facing and stay out of the drafting load path, rules stand alone with one generic illustration, and recognition of previously reviewed material is never announced nor a substitute for a fresh pass. v1.7.1 widens the structural negative-parallelism lint pattern to the 'X, never the Y' and 'not the X, but the Y' contrast families - pattern-level checks over phrase bans. v1.8: the casebook's load-path status becomes a documented lifecycle dial - out of the load path during testing/calibration, owner may opt it in afterwards as judgement context; the never-announce-recognition and disposition guards are permanent either way, and the dial setting is recorded in the ledger header. v1.8.1: lint gains quiet-claim advisories - sentence-initial 'Most X ...' frequency claims and 'more/better ... than <universal baseline>' comparatives are statistics even without a number. Recalibrated for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance): two new constraints every generated package must carry — length is a voice trait and the one the model overrides silently (default output runs longer than most people write, and lowering reasoning effort does not shorten it, so each variant states a length target in its own units, extracted from the corpus rather than guessed); and re-baseline the package when the underlying model changes (a package is calibrated against whatever prose baseline it was written on, and default length/register/hedging shift between generations — re-run the lint over every worked example, compare a fresh draft against a sample anchor, and record the baseline it was calibrated on).

plugins.name: customer-business-case
plugins.description: Generate a single printable A4-page executive business case in Diolog's house style from a customer's proposal deck. Uses the /design-craft skill against a bundled single-page DESIGN.md and a templated version of the Alfabs business case, with all copy in the Diolog brand voice (create-diolog-business-case). Produces one dense, print-clean page (problem, solution, value, quantified outcome, investment, next step) on a fixed 794x1123 A4 canvas that prints to exactly one page.

plugins.name: customer-deck-builder
plugins.description: Build a branded, print-ready customer proposal / pitch deck from Diolog's 9-slide template system. Fills company-agnostic templates with a specific client's identity, contacts, pricing and numbers (prompting with multiple-choice questions for missing details), keeps the IR-proposal spine, and can design new slides into the same system via design-craft. Outputs a single self-contained web page with pan/zoom (trackpad + controls, fit-deck / fit-slide / 100%) that prints to a vertical, paged PDF at native 1920×1080 slide size.

plugins.name: deck-craft
plugins.description: Self-contained slide-deck skill spanning three output targets from one body of deck craft: self-contained fixed-stage HTML presentations, lecturn.deck/1 JSON (and .pptx through the deckconv round-trip), and Diolog investor decks assembled from the 140-template / 12-recipe slide library. Carries its own visual-design layer rather than depending on a general design skill: consuming a supplied DESIGN.md or token file as binding context, authoring a direction when no brand exists (scheme / formality / density, subject-mined palettes, the signature element, the swap test), typography sized for projection with tracking and measure rules, colour strategy and accent budgets, five-vector hierarchy and cross-slide rhythm, anti-slop rules, and an accessibility floor calibrated for projection. Deck-specific narrative discipline: the title sequence as the deck's argument, speaking-vs-reading density, one idea per slide, deliver-the-whole-count, and the linear-flow usability rules (per-slide trunk test, recognition over recall, the honesty gate on charts and claims). Ships a per-slide build gate and a delivery review built on the verification epistemics that rendering an image is not seeing one, that the question you bring to a capture determines what you see in it, and that a clean gate means no known defect rather than verified. Direction evidence is read progressively from the template libraries on the machine (frontend-slides bold pack, open-design deck templates, portable design systems) without bulk-reading them. v1.1 folds the slide-template library into the skill: 200 layouts across 27 families, 21 recipes, the full slot contract and every validator rule. v1.2 closes the pipeline-integration gaps with the mandatory render_deck loop. v1.3.0 folds in portable ideas from impeccable. v1.7.0 turns the prose gate into an executable preflight probe. v1.8.0 hardens initial first-pass generation to eliminate design-review failure modes: establishes pure deterministic SVG charts by default, standardises Base64 asset inlining, and enforces dual-theme dark-band contrast tokens. v1.9.0 introduces dedicated Investor Relations & Retail Investor domain craft (references/investor-relations.md): ISO 9241-303 / AVIXA DISCAS closed-form typography legibility derivations, two-tier type floor preflight calibration, IBCS financial chart standards (shared-scale ROI comparison bars, zero-baseline mandate, waterfall bridge bounds), asymmetric editorial photo splits, brand geometric signatures (custom polygon chevrons, 8px grounding beams), uncompressed 12-slide quarterly and capital allocation recipes, floating minimalist glass chrome, and regulatory disclosure invariants (ASX GN14, ASIC RG 230, SEC Reg FD/G).

plugins.name: deep-research-prompt-creator
plugins.description: Turns a vague research need into a single copy-paste-ready Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Deep Research prompt — with pseudo-XML scaffolding, archetype-specific overrides (technical / competitive / regulatory / academic / forecasting), epistemic bounding tags, inline citation protocol, and wrap-around Operator Notes (Plan Review, decomposition, adversarial audit) that empirically matter as much as the prompt itself.

plugins.name: design-craft
plugins.description: Turn Claude into an opinionated, accessibility-aware, AI-slop-resistant design collaborator that produces intentional design artifacts in HTML/CSS/SVG/JS — landing pages, interactive prototypes, mobile app screens, slide decks, wireframes, hi-fi variations, design-token extractions, and component inventories. The SKILL.md carries a full design philosophy (content discipline, purposeful aesthetics that reject AI-template tropes, visual hierarchy and rhythm, typography and color systems, interface copy as design material, WCAG accessibility, interaction states, system thinking, respecting the medium) and routes to 29 phased procedures across production (discovery-questions, frontend-aesthetic-direction, wireframe, make-a-deck, make-a-prototype, make-tweakable, generate-variations, make-an-animation, make-a-doc, generate-images), craft (motion-design, gsap-motion, depth-and-3d, laws-of-composition, typesetting, data-viz, mobile-design), system (design-system-extract, component-extract, design-system-author), and review (unit-critique-gate, accessibility-audit, ai-slop-check, hierarchy-rhythm-review, interaction-states-pass, visual-verification, polish-pass). Built for Claude Code: AskUserQuestion for kickoff rounds, the Agent tool for ship-time review panels over real deliverables, and self-contained deck-scaling / device-frame / tweak-panel code that runs as standalone files. v1.2 adds mobile-design (iOS/Material platform grammar, thumb zone, input methods, industry conventions, emotional design), gsap-motion (timelines, ScrollTrigger scroll storytelling, SplitText, SVG draw/morph, Flip/Draggable — all plugins free via CDN), visual-verification (viewport-matrix layout integrity + screenshot playbook, a fifth polish-pass reviewer), an interface-copy chapter, subject-derived aesthetics with a plan-time signature element and swap-test genericness gate, and detection for all three current AI-default looks (warm-editorial, dark+acid-accent, broadsheet). v1.3 wires in local design-system libraries (open-design DESIGN.md format: brand systems as binding context, library systems as direction candidates, deck-template styles for deck variety), portable 9-section DESIGN.md emission from design-system-extract/author plus signature-moves capture, accent budgets written as enforceable usage rules, Karpathy-style surgical iteration discipline, and an interface-copy lens in the polish-pass jury. v1.4 adds an agentic-iteration layer — unit-critique-gate (a mid-build per-unit draft→critique→repair loop with a canonical scores+mustFix rubric, convergence budgets, and a don't-double-loop rule for orchestrated harnesses), a deterministic design-lint script (stdlib Python, runs in any seeded sandbox), an autonomous mode for orchestrated/headless runs (assumptions instead of questions, iterate harder), and per-unit visual micro-checks with honest degradation when no browser exists — plus the typesetting and data-viz craft references and the ux-craft companion skill as a standing dependency for flows, forms, and UX review. v1.5 adds a redesign procedure (references/redesign.md: preserve/overhaul mode detection, audit-before-touching incl. SEO/analytics dependencies, a never-change-silently list, and modernisation levers in priority order), optical/cross-card alignment checks in hierarchy-rhythm-review, logo-wall sourcing (Simple Icons / SVG monograms, logos-only) and bento background-diversity rules in ai-slop-check, the double-bezel nested-enclosure technique in depth-and-3d, and a deliver-the-whole-count rule for multi-unit briefs — selected synthesis from the taste-skill corpus. v1.6 hardens verification into an epistemics rather than a checklist: visual-verification gains a Phase 0 verification contract (rendering a screenshot is not seeing one; ask each capture "what is wrong with this?" not "is this done?"; a gate is downstream of the findings that motivated it, so a clean lint means no known defect is present and never means verified; prove every new rule can fail by running it against the artifact that motivated it; coverage is silent because a selector matching nothing passes; crop to components at DPR 2-3 because a page thumbnail cannot resolve the defect; measure ink via a baseline probe plus canvas TextMetrics.actualBoundingBoxAscent rather than getBoundingClientRect boxes; and static checks are structurally blind to motion), a three-line report shape separating what a machine asserts from what you looked at from what you did not check, make-a-doc's print freeze reworked around the resting-style-is-final-style contract (invert the states when you own the CSS; the negative-delay skip is the fallback for stylesheets you don't), motion-design's review gaining the three-pass motion verification (print at rest, reduced-motion at rest, mid-flight frames) and an explicit z-index rule for transient overlays, and unit-critique-gate spelling out that a clean lint licenses one sentence and it is not "verified". v1.7 adds two render-breaking CSS mechanics to §15 that are invisible in source — cascade layers lose to any unlayered rule regardless of specificity (so `@layer` on a component makes it lose to an unlayered base reset, not win), and a sizing `height` attribute defeats CSS `aspect-ratio` and distorts the image (set `height:auto`) — plus a rendered-vs-natural aspect-ratio probe in visual-verification's Media check, and a mobile-header rule in mobile-design (collapse the action cluster to logo + one compact action + the menu toggle, or an overflowing cluster pushes the toggle off-screen and unreachable while a fixed-header page-overflow probe stays clean). v1.8 recalibrates the skill for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance): a Working-posture chapter fixes narration cadence (one line before the first tool call, updates only on findings or direction changes, outcome-first at the end), calibrates both output lengths (the reply and any written deliverable, including a length-is-part-of-the-design rule in make-a-doc and a standing end-of-file reminder), holds scope explicitly (concerns raised in a sentence, then build what was asked), limits correction narration to errors that change the user's decisions, and rewrites delegation from a default into an exception — verification is first-person (the value of a fresh reviewer is the question they bring, not the second context), unit-critique-gate's per-unit reviewer becomes self-critique in a deliberately separate pass with fan-out reserved for large or batched units, accessibility-audit's four agents and hierarchy-rhythm's two become checklists run in one pass, polish-pass sizes its panel to the deliverable and skips lenses whose subject isn't present, and the four make-a-deck / make-a-prototype / make-an-animation / depth-and-3d 'dispatch a verifier subagent' instructions become do-the-looking-yourself; agent briefs are now ordered artifact-first and task-last; the find-wide-then-filter rule is stated explicitly (a reviewer told to be conservative reports less, not better); the 'when unsure, run the review anyway' trigger is replaced with matching the trigger to what the artifact actually contains; discovery-questions front-loads every direction-changing question into one round because a complete brief left to run is the best condition to work in; multi-unit builds keep a resumable ledger instead of winding down early; visual-verification states that looking is cheaper than reasoning about what you'd see; and Space Grotesk joins Inter/Roboto/Arial/Fraunces as a banned silent default in SKILL.md §6, ai-slop-check, frontend-aesthetic-direction and design-lint.py — it is the face the model reaches for when *asked* to be distinctive, which makes it the opposite. v1.9 hands deck production to the new self-contained deck-craft skill: references/make-a-deck.md becomes a pointer and the router row redirects, so slides are owned by one skill spanning HTML, lecturn.deck/1 JSON/.pptx, and the 140-template Diolog investor library instead of a deck reference inside a general design skill. v1.10.0 imports the portable ideas from the impeccable skill: a visitor-mode taxonomy (Persuade / Operate / Read / Experience, chosen from the requested surface not the product) with a new references/visitor-modes.md carrying the Operate/Read depth that inverts the skill's Persuade-tuned defaults (earned familiarity, one type family, fixed rem scale not fluid, state-rich semantic vocabulary, a second neutral layer, structural responsive behaviour, no page-load choreography, and the permissions product surfaces are allowed) plus a matching polish-pass lens and discovery question; an anti-convergence direction procedure in frontend-aesthetic-direction (name the category's rut AND its predictable opposite before generating, derive seven candidates from the audience's cultural world including its graphic and screen traditions spanning at least three material families, and don't build your own top-ranked candidate because it is what every run would ship, plus a standing canon exit that is the user's door and never the recommendation); the five-block direction contract (THESIS / OWN-WORLD / STORY / FIRST VIEWPORT / FORM plus a FINISH line) written into the emitted markup so a build can't erase it, replacing the old token comment block, with the cream/paper/parchment rendition self-check on warm and bookish subjects; a comp-before-build phase (three comps at the surface's own viewport, one approval point, reproduction before enhancement, a written medium inventory, and the rule that the comp outranks every written record of it); the medium gate in generate-images (medium decided by what a region shows, never by what feels buildable: figures, objects, machinery and any named texture are raster whatever the stack, style doesn't move the boundary, authored SVG ends where drawing skill begins, and a field carries a written quantity commitment); review upgrades in unit-critique-gate and polish-pass (a computed disposition of ship/fix/rebuild reported verbatim, a rebuild directive when contradiction is the page rather than the exception because a patch list launders a rejection into an approval, a verdict pass scoring each repair resolved/partial/unresolved against the recapture since narration is not evidence, mandatory TYPE and MATERIAL rows, a first-unit hero checkpoint, fresh-never-forked reviewer contexts, the specificity judgment formed before reading deterministic findings, and a mandatory one-line disclosure for any degraded or skipped lens); the identity lock and default-vs-departure modes in generate-variations (one sentence of what is actually on screen in real values with no aesthetic-family label, six primary axes with three variants on three different axes, the squint test's family-pass-before-sentence-pass, and a per-intent differentiation table); a visual-weight-scaled knob budget in make-tweakable (leaf 0, small 0-1, medium 2, large 2-4, hard cap 4); browser surfaces as a first-class craft check (selection, caret, scrollbars, focus rings, underline offset, tabular numerals, the cheapest built-not-assembled signal); truth binds claims not demonstrations (author demonstration data at full fidelity and label it synthetic; commercial and factual claims stay uninventable; refusing a bold direction because its demo data doesn't exist yet is timidity wearing honesty's clothes); scope sovereignty (no new system primitive without asking) and the flat-section diagnosis (a flat section opted out of the system's own strongest moves); never-split-the-difference redesign semantics; a bounded verification ceiling (batched rounds, desktop and mobile together, fixes batched between rounds, stop when a round resolves nothing); and new bans for imitation material, hard offset block shadows, system display faces, glyph-as-icon, mono-as-costume and the reflex modal, alongside an explicit carve-out that the SVG ban targets pictures and never geometry.

plugins.name: design-md-from-screenshots
plugins.description: Reverse-engineer a product's visual design system from one or more website/app screenshots and produce a single authoritative DESIGN.md — a framework-agnostic, token-based spec (palette, typography, spacing, shape, motion, component inventory, voice, do/don't) with per-token provenance marks, so another AI (Stitch, Claude, v0, Cursor, AI Elements) can generate new screens that unmistakably belong to the same product.

plugins.name: design-md-from-website
plugins.description: Generate a spec-compliant DESIGN.md for any live website from its real pages — the browser-driven, measure-first successor to design-md-from-screenshots. Given a URL it uses Obscura (parallel probe agents with rate-limit backoff, full-page screenshots over CDP + getComputedStyle-by-role measured tokens + a colour census, read from the spacing longhands) to MEASURE the design of the key pages (home, about, product/services, contact, and any investor hub/portal) instead of guessing hexes and fonts from a screenshot, then synthesises an authoritative DESIGN.md in the official google-labs design.md format (YAML token frontmatter + Overview/Colors/Typography/Layout/Elevation/Shapes/Components/Do's & Don'ts + per-token provenance + self-critique) and refines it into an intentional, upgraded identity.

plugins.name: diolog-brand-voice
plugins.description: Three skills that write publish-ready, on-brand content in Diolog's brand voice (Australian investor-communication SaaS; 'the workspace for everything investor-facing'; tagline 'Disclosure, without doubt.'), all driven by one bundled brand-voice persona and gated by one deterministic voice-lint. create-diolog-article writes long-form articles / blog posts / thought-leadership across the investor-education, IR-best-practice, thought-leadership and announcement registers. create-diolog-marketing-copy writes website marketing copy and marketing emails (benefit-first heroes, feature-to-'so what' bullets, problem-callback CTAs, subject/preview/body emails). create-diolog-business-case writes buyer-facing ROI / justification documents for the CFO / Company Secretary / board (status-quo cost -> what changes -> proof/security/compliance posture -> measurable outcomes -> next step). Every skill hard-encodes the house rules: no em or en dashes (spaced hyphen only), Australian English, sentence-case headings (except product feature names), every statistic carries an inline (Source, Year) with zero fabrication, compliance confidence capped at 95%, no financial advice or guaranteed outcomes, the Diolog narrative arc, correct register selection, and critique the old way of IR never the reader. The deterministic diolog_voice_lint.py hard-fails on em/en dashes and banned/AI-tell phrases and advises on American spellings, over-claim/guarantee language and citation coverage. The fuller brand counterpart to the deployed diolog-content-writer / diolog-linkedin-writer generation prompts; personal-voice LinkedIn posts remain with create-luke-content.

plugins.name: diolog-site-builder
plugins.description: Build or extend a company website or standalone investor centre by composing gate-tested HTML blocks, theming them from DESIGN.md, filling copy from VOICE.md, and wiring Diolog live-data markers. Use for a marketing site, investor portal, site artifact, site structure + design + voice conversion, or when adding pages, sections, images, and explicit custom workspace blocks. Prefer this over hand-writing whole pages because the shared chrome, responsive system, and stock blocks already pass the Studio gates. Triggers include "build the company site", "generate the investor centre", "scaffold a marketing site", "make a site from this DESIGN.md/VOICE.md", "add a pricing page", and "theme this template to the brand".

plugins.name: diolog-tasks-pipeline
plugins.description: Three native skills that run the Diolog Tasks issue pipeline — triage, plan, and worker — entirely inside your interactive Claude Code session (no Agent SDK, so usage draws from your standard interactive allowance, not the separate Agent SDK credit). Formerly linear-issue-pipeline; now targets the diolog-tasks MCP (mcp.diolog.com.au). tasks-triage runs a technical + Specification Sentinel product review and posts a non-technical readiness comment; tasks-plan classifies a tier, investigates the codebase, writes docs/plans/{id}.md and comments the repo-relative path (no file upload); tasks-worker implements a planned issue in an isolated worktree via dynamic ultracode workflows (understand → implement → rebase → acceptance review → resolve), with no remote PR. The plan and worker fan out parallel subagents via the Workflow tool to speed up large investigations. Recalibrated for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance), ported from the generalized twin: tasks-worker's per-phase gate is explicitly a conformance check (evidence-shaped — the clause, the file:line, the gate you ran) rather than a second correctness review stacked on a phase that already reviewed itself; adversarial finding-verification is aimed at Criticals, structural fixes, and locked-decision reversals rather than blanket 1:1, and no reviewer is briefed to be conservative; the completion comment keeps to tables/counts/drops/gates rather than narrating the phases; and tasks-triage/tasks-plan gain the effort dial plus length budgets. All three point at the twin's new pipeline-wide canonical feature-spec-pipeline/skills/work/references/model-and-effort.md. v2.4.0 (from the WEB-4905 110-ticket audit): a fourth skill, tasks-verify — an independent fresh-session acceptance verifier that re-derives requirements from the ticket and closes them on typed behavioural evidence (browser measurements, exercised requests, stored-row counts) before a ticket is treated as done; evidence-typed clause rows with no partial status; the affected-test sweep + regression-discrimination proof; the two-probe blocker protocol replacing 'record as unverified'; a scope-narrowing check at all plan tiers; plans committed (comment carries the sha); a merge-mode that routes operator-requested merges through ship-feature's fail-closed gate; and the self-review stack trimmed per Opus 5 over-verification guidance.

plugins.name: discovery-sentinel
plugins.description: Analyze product discovery and customer feedback session documents using the Discovery Sentinel persona. Types sessions by purpose (discovery vs demo), segments distinct client companies, and produces lean Feedback Classification Reports, Discovery Insight Briefs, readable Prioritised Opportunity Assessments, an Action Checklist, and company-specific Sales Discovery Companions — with confidence scoring, JTBD extraction, bias detection, and compliance flagging for regulated B2B SaaS. Includes a trend-synthesis mode across prior analyses.

plugins.name: doc-summarizer
plugins.description: Compress a verbose source document — README, API docs, research paper, technical guide, library docs — into a maximally dense, semantically complete Markdown reference (written to a `<source>.summary.md` file) that another LLM or a skimming human can consume in a fraction of the tokens. Uses a triage-tag system ([CRITICAL]/[WORKFLOW]/[POWER-USER]/[GOLDEN-NUGGET]/[DEPRECATED]), contextually integrated tips, solution-first problem framing, multi-tier feature capture, and a mandatory Strategic Synthesis footer (Maturity Model + Feature Selection Matrix + Workflow Progression Ladder). Target compression 60–80% while retaining 100% of semantically unique information.

plugins.name: email-mockups
plugins.description: Turn a named Diolog feature (or several) into email-ready product-mockup graphics on a Figma canvas. Reads the feature's real context — docs/marketing/product-feature-guide.md + features-build/plain/NN-*.md + the rendered mock UI read in a browser via Obscura (the served web / customer / investor design-system hosts) — then designs and builds, via the design-craft skill, impression-not-replica mockups that lead with the feature's payoff (a full product-window app shot — the complete app shell in a clean window — for hero features, plus a product-surface vignette, soft panel + peeking device, collage/overlap, phone bezel, and a website frame for actual public sites) and make the product look genuinely smart (a real insight, an italic quote from the record, named source chips) as titled, spaced artboards in one self-contained HTML file using the live design tokens, and recreates that layout in Figma via whatever write-capable Figma MCP is connected. Each artboard also carries a brief non-technical marketing caption beneath it for IR teams and the agencies who serve them (no em-dashes), with an optional email-hero split format, and semantic emphasis via a soft wash and icon rather than AI-slop left-only borders. If no Figma MCP is present, the HTML file is the final deliverable.

plugins.name: feature-spec-pipeline
plugins.description: Four native skills that run an issue-tracker-free, markdown-doc feature pipeline — /triage, /plan, /work, /gap-fix — entirely inside your interactive Claude Code session. /triage turns a feature idea (inline text or a notes file) into a versioned spec at docs/specs/spec-DIO-0001.md (id allocated from docs/feature-specs/LEDGER.md), running a codebase grounding pass plus a Specification Sentinel product/UX/compliance review and appending a non-technical readiness section. /plan classifies a tier, investigates the codebase, writes docs/plans/plan-DIO-0001.md and links it from the spec. /work implements the plan in an isolated worktree via dynamic ultracode workflows (understand → implement → rebase → acceptance review → resolve), appends a progress section to the spec, and leaves the branch local — no remote PR. /gap-fix runs after /work as the remediation step: it re-enters the work branch, ALWAYS re-audits the delivered code against the original spec (merging in any human/QA gaps you provide), and implements the fixes in code (file-disjoint fan-out + typecheck gates), looping audit→fix until only optional Low items remain, then commits locally and appends a gap-fix progress note — no remote PR. The plan, work, and gap-fix skills fan out parallel subagents via the Workflow tool (in small batches to avoid throttling). A doc-driven sibling of diolog-tasks-pipeline that needs no Diolog Tasks MCP. Recalibrated for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance) with a new pipeline-wide canonical reference, skills/work/references/model-and-effort.md: the model × effort lane calibration (per-lane effort levels, `low` as the level built for subagents, effort-before-model because REVIEWER ≥ WRITER is about capability class not spend, `xhigh` + 64k `max_tokens` for long-horizon runners, hold-effort-constant for the prompt cache, never hardcode a dated model id in a wire self-check); the oracle-checks-vs-re-reading-your-own-work distinction that says which of the pipeline's heavy verification still earns its tokens; and a length budget for every written artifact. Applied across the skills: /work and tasks-worker's per-phase gate is now explicitly a conformance check rather than a second correctness review, adversarial finding-verification is aimed at Criticals/structural fixes rather than blanket 1:1, and no reviewer is ever briefed to 'be conservative' (followed literally, it lowers recall — report everything and filter after); triage and plan gain length budgets and the effort dial.

plugins.name: feedback-archivist
plugins.description: Turn messy, multi-source customer-discovery/feedback dumps (Slack exports, Google-Drive "Notes by Gemini" .docx meeting notes, segment-foldered research/ICPs/personas, AI-Studio JSON repos, screenshot evidence, audio/video) into ONE clean, deduplicated, verbatim Markdown archive organised by buyer segment with an INDEX — the pre-step that feeds discovery-sentinel and product-strategist. Converts docx/pdf/txt via pandoc, classifies meetings by attendee email domain + source folder, dedupes identical content + notes/transcript pairs + Slack recaps, mines Slack for product feedback (dropping bots/internal-eng/test noise), strips Google/Gemini auto-summaries only where a transcript exists, and builds a who's-who INDEX with provenance and probable dates.

plugins.name: improve-prompt
plugins.description: Review and rewrite prompts, system prompts, agent instructions, CLAUDE.md files, and Claude Code skills against Anthropic's prompt-engineering guidance and the Karpathy coding-behaviour principles. Diagnoses the artifact with a structured rubric (clarity, examples, XML structure, output format, hallucination guards, consistency, guardrails, token weight, rule craft, and — for skills — trigger description quality and progressive disclosure), then delivers a surgical rewrite with per-change rationale. Bundles the full Anthropic prompting docs (best practices, Opus 4.8 guide, guardrail guides, four production use-case guides) and the Karpathy material three ways: the guidelines verbatim, worked before/after examples, and a prompt-craft dissection (karpathy-prompt-craft.md) that treats the guidelines as a model of rule-writing — principle anatomy (name, bold directive, checkable behaviour bullets, self-test), tradeoff clauses, imperative-to-verifiable transforms, ownership-scoped cleanup, working-if success signals, a cross-surface reuse pattern (one canonical rule text wrapped per surface), and a mergeable hardening block — which the skill applies to every prompt it improves.

plugins.name: lecturn-deck
plugins.description: Convert PowerPoint (.pptx) ⇄ the lecturn.deck/1 JSON slide schema, and author/validate that JSON, with the bundled spec and a stdlib-only Python two-way converter. Import a .pptx to an editable deck/slide/element tree (media extracted, fidelity F0–F3 reported, no silent loss), or build a structurally valid .pptx from a deck JSON. Includes a specialist agent for multi-step convert-validate-verify loops.

plugins.name: log-bugs-to-diolog-tasks
plugins.description: Create Diolog Tasks issues from a code-review markdown report. Each `### [SEVERITY] Title` finding becomes one issue with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low) and type (Vulnerability/Bug) labels and Todo status. Formerly log-bugs-to-linear; now targets the diolog-tasks MCP. Preserves the reviewer's exact prose, file:line citations, fix recommendations, and confidence scores.

plugins.name: mac-design-digest
plugins.description: Incrementally digest macOS app UI screenshots, app icons, and official Apple UI kits (user-supplied, e.g. from macapp.supply; .sketch kits are deconstructed directly from their JSON) into a persistent design corpus — per-app token profiles with framework-lineage classification (AppKit-native vs Catalyst vs iOS-on-Mac vs web-Electron; only native evidence feeds canon), cross-app pattern entries, aesthetic style clusters, icon anatomy digests, and a master TASTE.md — powered by a Mac Design Archivist persona, a deep-research knowledge base (14-point screenshot rubric, anti-pattern taxonomy, WCAG/HIG thresholds), and a macOS-native grammar reference (Liquid Glass layer discipline, selection/accent/density tells, concentric-corner geometry, 10-point native-tells audit). Then designs beautiful, native-feeling macOS mocks and icons from the corpus, auditing its own output against both rubrics before delivery. Recalibrated for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance): design mode's pre-delivery audit now opens the render before scoring it (a rubric scored off the source is scored off the wrong artifact — render, crop each region at DPR 2-3, read the crops asking 'what is wrong with this?', first-person rather than delegated), and the batch summary's deltas-only rule is stated as a length rule too, since written output drifts long by default.

plugins.name: mac-design-studio
plugins.description: Design beautiful, varied, authentically native macOS app UIs and app icons from scratch — full mock windows (HTML/CSS or token-precise spec) and 1024pt icon designs (SVG or Icon Composer layer spec), each committed to a named aesthetic direction drawn from a catalogue synthesised from 135 curated macapp.supply apps and 134 icons, grounded in Apple's macOS 27 UI kit (control ladder, type ramp, label tiers, chrome metrics) and the HIG. Routes native correctness to the macosify HIG library and craft/variation/polish to design-craft and ux-craft, audits every delivery against a 10-point native-tells audit and 14-point quality rubric, and enforces variety discipline so consecutive designs don't converge to one template. Every design declares one signature element and one justified aesthetic risk (with an AI-default calibration guard on the looks generators overuse), directions are calibration not a closed menu (hybrids and novel directions welcome when the subject earns them), and an incorporated fluid-interface motion layer (springs, interruptibility, materials-on-web, optical typography, reduced-motion floor — from Apple's WWDC design corpus) covers interactive mocks and ships a motion spec with static ones. v1.2 adds the essence layer: references/mac-essence.md distils the eight convictions of great mac app design from the corpus + UX canon (familiarity-as-canvas, restraint-as-confidence, the surface's single question, states-are-the-quality, words-as-load-bearing, forgiveness-over-interrogation, the keyboard, invisible completeness) plus a yield table where design-craft/ux-craft web-first rules bend to mac grammar (cursor, targets, casing, toasts); the build step now designs states-not-screens (ideal + empty rendered, full state matrix specified with real unhappy-path copy), writes the real words per macOS copy grammar, names keyboard behaviour, and delivery adds the essence test (name the question, the signature, and the worst state's behaviour); ux-craft is elevated to a standing dependency. Recalibrated for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance): the AI-default calibration now works at the type level as well as the direction level (Space Grotesk is the face this model reaches for when told to be distinctive, which makes it the opposite of distinctive — a font you can defend in one sentence is a choice, a name you arrived at before you had a reason is gravity); the delivery audit opens the render first-person (serve, crop at DPR 2-3, read each crop asking 'what is wrong with this?' — rendering a screenshot is not seeing one, and looking is cheaper than reasoning about what you would see); and the delivery note is length-calibrated so the token table an implementer needs isn't buried under restated rationale. v1.4 rebuilds the icon practice on evidence: a bundled 532-icon corpus (the 500 most recent macosicongallery.com icons, 2022-2026, plus 32 ground-truth macOS 26 'Tahoe' captures of Apple's own system set), every icon vision-analysed per-icon with a cross-corpus synthesis; icon-directions.md gains the Tahoe gel-glass grammar (nine tells: cushion tiles, porcelain-vs-saturated ground registers, poured/frosted glyphs, white-as-material with ground-hue bleed, authored overlap blends), a rewritten current-era direction with three sub-registers, eleven new subject-mining devices, and a ten-point failure anti-checklist from the 500-icon evidence; and icon commissions now produce a variation set, never a single take — one shared spec rendered through three engines (a hand-authored layered Icon-Composer-ready SVG master, a media-gen-pro Arrow vector take, and media-gen-pro GPT-Image raster takes steered by corpus reference images), judged on a 1024/128/32/16 contact sheet.

plugins.name: macosify
plugins.description: Three macOS-native UI skills sharing one bundled knowledge corpus (the full macOS 26 'Tahoe'/Liquid Glass HIG library + a token-level DESIGN.md + the macOS 26 UI Extraction & Native Translation framework). `macosify` refits an existing UI to feel authentically AppKit-native on macOS 26, correcting iOS-derived looks (Mac Catalyst / 'Designed for iPad' on Apple Silicon) toward true native. `macos-ui-analyst` (the GlassReader persona) analyses a static macOS 26 screenshot into a structured Native Translation Report (AX-tree inventory + SwiftUI/AppKit mapping) and merges durable learnings into one accumulating knowledge file. `macos-storyboard` reads the entire corpus, then builds an interactive StyleX + Storybook storyboard of a specification's user flows — a reusable design system (tokens → elements → composites) with every screen rendered across happy / empty / loading / error / AI states, using the design-craft and frontend-design skills for bespoke, accessible direction.

plugins.name: marketing-docs-maintenance
plugins.description: Keep the Diolog marketing/feature documentation set in the diolog-team-files repo (~/Dev/diolog-team-files/web) current when a feature ships or a Diolog Tasks ticket lands. Updates the two assembled published docs — existing-features-technical.md (full technical detail) and exhisting-features-marketing.md (plain, non-technical) — plus the per-area detail under existing-features-references/ (final/ + plain/ numbered per area 01-22, backed by the live/ and raw/ capture layers), and the auxiliary surfaces outbound-contact-surfaces.md, ui-interaction-details.md, and INCORPORATED.md (reconciliation ledger).
